# The metrics of an old vLLM release: the prefix cache counters are named
# gpu_prefix_cache_* and the KV cache gauge gpu_cache_usage_perc. The
# counters of the cross-instance cache, the prompt tokens per source and
# the waiting requests per reason did not exist yet.
